record.text: Fun fact: Development on the iPhone Duo started back in 2010. However, Steve Jobs would instantly snap every prototype he got in half and demand they make it stronger. Tim Apple kept this up in honour of Steve's legacy. It is only with John Apple that it could finally be released to production.

record.text:
BOO—the #iPhoneDuo case is only available in Navy Blue and "Sand."

For the second time today, I'll say it: promoting a folding phone accessory with the word "sand" is a bold move.

The neutrality (read: boringness) and small number of options gives a good clue how many Apple expects to sell, too.
